rules.sourceText: For all majors, except for Chemical and Molecular Engineering (CME): ESM 213 - Introduction to Nanotechnology Studies 3 credits; Two semesters (at least 6 credits) of independent research (299, 499 or 488). requirements.sourceText: Completion of the minor requires 18-22 credits and consists of the following requirements: For all majors, except for Chemical and Molecular Engineering (CME): ESM 213; two semesters (at least 6 credits) of independent research (299, 499 or 488); two technical electives from BME 381, ESM 339, PHY 472, ESE 331, CHE 378 OR ESM 378, MEC 470, EST 391, ESM 212; ESM 400. For students who are majoring in Chemical and Molecular Engineering (CME): completion of the three course requirement for the specialization in Nanotechnology; two semesters (at least 6 credits) of independent research (299, 499 or 488); ESM 400.

policies.sourceText: All courses for the minor must be passed with an average grade of B or higher.

notes.text: Students should check the schedule of courses for current scheduling information, as not all courses are offered every semester.

The minor is intended for students in majors from the College of Engineering and Applied Sciences or the College of Arts and Sciences. Research must be in the student's own major area and integrated with the minor through approved research topics.
